{{Otheruses|Squad One}}
'''Squad One''' was a squad of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ships were gray with orange markings to identify their squad affiliation.
